patch.objective: Applying software supply chain security: Binary Authorization, the SLSA framework

sources.cite: Google Cloud, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer exam guide (new version, live November 23): foundational infrastructure and governance ~18%, CI/CD pipelines ~30%, SRE practices ~18%, observability and troubleshooting ~22%, performance and cost optimization ~12%
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch of the PDF on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 2.2 'Deployment strategies (e.g., canary, blue/green, rolling, traffic splitting, feature flags)' 'and defining success metrics based on application or ML pipeline telemetry'; 5.2 'Optimizing resource usage for cost and efficiency'. sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Binary Authorization: Key concepts
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: rule evaluation modes 'Allow all images', 'Disallow all images', 'Require attestations'; enforcement 'Block and Audit Log' versus 'Dry Run: Audit Log Only'; an attestation is a signed document over the image digest, verified by an attestor's public key; exempt images are always allowed via admissionWhitelistPatterns (patterns can match a whole registry path). The breakglass procedure is on a separate page not read here (to verify); the denial message wording is from memory.
